newsitem.title: USA: Game Financial sees more growth in FY97.
newsitem.headline: Game Financial sees more growth in FY97.

text.p: Game Financial Corp said Thursday early signs indicate 1997 should be another year of significant growth, based on fourth quarter results in 1996.
The company reported net income of $432,000, or $0.09 a share, in the period ended December 31, compared to $296,000, or $0.06 a share, in the fourth quarter of 1995.
Sales rose to $5.7 million from $2.4 million thanks to expanded sales marketing efforts, the company said.
Game Financial provides financial services, primarily to customers of gaming establishments.
Its shares were unchanged Thursday at 7-3/4.
